description: This Java source file defines a utility class AlarmUtil for managing alarms within an Android application. It includes methods for scheduling, cancelling, and calculating next alarm times, utilizing Android's AlarmManager and PendingIntent APIs.

classes.name: AlarmUtil
classes.description: A utility class for scheduling, cancelling, and managing alarms using Android's AlarmManager.

methods.name: AlarmUtil
methods.description: Constructor that initializes AlarmUtil with a context and retrieves the AlarmManager service.

methods.name: scheduleAlarm
methods.description: Schedules an alarm based on the provided Alarm object, setting alarm time and creating a PendingIntent.

methods.name: cancelAlarm
methods.description: Cancels a previously scheduled alarm based on the provided Alarm object.

methods.name: getNextAlarmTime
methods.description: Calculates and returns the next occurrence of an alarm given hour and minute, adjusting for past times.

methods.name: readAlarm
methods.description: Static method to reconstruct an Alarm object from a Bundle of extras.

methods.name: writeAlarm
methods.description: Static method to serialize an Alarm object into a Bundle of extras.
